Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Vilnius hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 10, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 15 Vilnius hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Agoda at 6, the hotel's own site at 3, Evendo at 1, Kiwi.com at 1, Super.com at 1 and Traveluro at 1. These are the Vilnius rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 13 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Agoda at 5, the hotel's own site at 3, Super.com at 2, Bluepillow.com at 1, br.Bluepillow.com at 1, Hotels.com at 1 and Traveluro at 1 (a tie counts for each site). Taxes and fees at Vilnius hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 18% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Solo Society Hybrid Hotel Vilnius to 20% at ibis Vilnius Centre. At 1 hotel the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
